sections.Geometry: Ceramic base box 3.2 x 2.5 x ~0.56 (about 70 percent of height, DERIVED) topped by a metal lid 3.0 x 2.3 x ~0.24 (lid inset 0.1 per side, DERIVED, UNCERTAIN) that sits on the ceramic ring. Four metallized pads wrap the bottom corners and appear as small notches or wraparound strips on the side faces (castellation optional at LOD2). Lid has a small chamfer or corner mark; the part-number print reads left to right with pin 1 at the upper-left corner (NDK/Epson; Abracon prints pin 1 at lower-left).
sections.Leads / Pins / Terminals: 4 flat pads: pad numbering (OHMNI default: pin 1 top-left per NDK/Epson, counter-clockwise; Abracon variant has pin 1 bottom-left): 1 = (-1.1, 0.8), 2 = (-1.1, -0.8), 3 = (1.1, -0.8), 4 = (1.1, 0.8) (counter-clockwise direction inferred; vendor texts fix only pin 1). Pads 1 and 3 are the crystal terminals, 2 and 4 are NC/ground (diagonal). Pad shape flat rectangle 1.0 x 0.9, thickness 0.02 (visual), MAT_GOLD. 2-pad variant (not default): pads at the two short ends, full width. DELTA vs Addendum 17.2 recorded in the family section.
sections.PCB Interface: SMD pads on the land pattern; body centered on the pad pattern: body_offset (0,0). Standoff 0 (underside at Z = 0). Pin 1 at (-1.1, 0.8) (center of the pad contact area).
sections.Materials: Base MAT_CERAMIC_PKG_TAN (proposed token; alt MAT_CERAMIC_ALUMINA_WHITE), lid MAT_STEEL_STAINLESS/MAT_NICKEL (brushed), pads MAT_GOLD, print MAT_SILKSCREEN_WHITE.
sections.Appearance: Silver-gray metal lid with a laser-printed frequency/code and a dot or chamfer on the pin-1 corner; the ceramic base is tan to light brown (visible as a thin band). sections.Orientation Markings: Pin 1 at the upper-left (-X,+Y) when the lid print reads left to right (NDK/Epson convention; Abracon parts: lower-left, parameter pin1_corner). Add a pin-1 dot on the lid near that corner (OHMNI convention) and a chamfered lid corner at LOD2.
sections.Recognition Features: 1. Metal rectangular lid on ceramic base. 2. 3.2 x 2.5 footprint with four corner pads. 3. Very low height (1.0 max). 4. Pin-1 dot/chamfer.
sections.Parametric Variants: Parameters: size (3225), height, pad_count (2/4), lid_inset, mark. Coupled: pads inside the body outline; height >= 0.35 and <= 1.0; pad X center + pad_x/2 <= L/2.
sections.Recommended Base Geometry: Two stacked boxes (ceramic, lid); four thin pad boxes; optional corner chamfer.
sections.Modeling Procedure: 1. Ceramic box at Z=0. 2. Lid on top, inset. 3. Four pad plates on the bottom corners (optionally wrapping 0.1 up the sides). 4. Chamfer/dot at pin 1. 5. Print decal.
sections.LOD Strategy: LOD0: single box. LOD1: ceramic + lid, four pads, pin-1 dot. LOD2: castellations, lid chamfer, seam, print.
sections.Simplification Rules: May omit: castellation, lid seam, print. NEVER omit: lid/ceramic two-tone, four pads, pin 1 mark, size.
sections.Sources: Abracon ABM8G datasheet https://abracon.com/Resonators/ABM8G.pdf (S3: 3.2 x 2.5 x 1.0 mm, pin 1 bottom-left note, chamfer note). See PKG-XTAL_SMD sources. Gap-fill: NDK NX3225GD (Digi-Key-hosted, S3: 3.2 +/-0.1 x 2.5 +/-0.1 x 0.80 typ / 1.0 max); Epson FA-238V / TSX-3225 (lcsc/chipdip-hosted, S4: 0.7 / 0.6, pin 1 upper-left); Epson TG3225CEN footprint numbers recorded in the family.
